translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.72:1: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation
verses.72:2: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺
verses.72:3: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring
verses.72:4: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah
verses.72:5: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah
verses.72:6: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness
verses.72:7: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺
verses.72:8: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
verses.72:9: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them
verses.72:10: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
verses.72:11: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions
verses.72:12: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
verses.72:13: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged
verses.72:14: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance
verses.72:15: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
verses.72:16: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
verses.72:17: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
verses.72:18: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him
verses.72:19: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him
verses.72:20: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
verses.72:21: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
verses.72:22: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him
verses.72:23: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever
verses.72:24: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower
verses.72:25: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it
verses.72:26: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone
verses.72:27: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
verses.72:28: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
